{{Top|leg}}
'''Bloat eel''' was a delicacy that needed to be prepared with great care. If not skinned while alive, the animal might impart its natural [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to its flesh. Because the bloat eel toxin was potentially [[Death/Legends|fatal]], functions that served the dish were staffed with [[Medtech Industries/Legends|medtech]]s ready and able to administer anti-toxins. Both [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] attended formal engagements at which the dish was served.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
